introHtml: Moisture wicking sportswear pulls sweat away from the skin, keeping your team dry and comfortable during physical activity. Unlike standard cotton shirts, these polyester or blended fabrics dry quickly and resist odors, making them ideal for corporate 5Ks, warehouse uniforms, or outdoor events. Add your logo with screen printing or embroidery for a professional look that performs.
